              <svg ng-if="vm.exampleCopyStatus !== 'Copy'" width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="panel-icon-btn" data-tip="Download" aria-label="Download" ng-click="vm.downloadExampleCode()">
              <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="panel-info" ng-if="vm.currentExampleWarn()">
          <span class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12"/><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8"/></svg></span>
          <div class="info-stack">
            <p>The example hard-codes a sys_id for illustration only - never hard-code sys_ids in real code; pass them in as the parameter. <button type="button" class="std-link std-link-ed" ng-click="vm.openStandard('do-not-use-hard-coded-values')">Standard: Do not use hard-coded values ▸</button></p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <pre class="code" ng-bind-html="vm.currentExampleHtml()"></pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="modal-overlay" ng-if="vm.preview.open" gs-modal="vm.closePreview()" gs-modal-focus="previewCloseBtn" ng-click="$event.target === $event.currentTarget && vm.closePreview()">
    <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Record preview">
      <div class="modal-head">
        <span ng-if="vm.preview.kind !== 'stats'">Record preview - <code>{{vm.preview.table}}</code></span>
        <span ng-if="vm.preview.kind === 'stats'">Aggregate preview - <code>{{vm.preview.table}}</code></span>
        <button id="previewCloseBtn" class="icon-x" type="button" aria-label="Close" ng-click="vm.closePreview()">✕</button>
      </div>
      <p class="modal-hint" ng-if="vm.preview.kind !== 'stats'">Up to 10 real records from the connected instance, matching the current example query. Read-only - nothing here is ever written back.</p>
      <p class="modal-hint" ng-if="vm.preview.kind === 'stats'">Real aggregate results from the connected instance, matching the current example query. Read-only - nothing here is ever written back.</p>
      <div class="preview-body">
        <p class="hint" ng-if="vm.preview.loading">Loading…</p>
        <p class="hint" ng-if="vm.preview.error">{{vm.preview.error}}</p>
        <p class="hint" ng-if="!vm.preview.loading && !vm.preview.error && vm.preview.kind !== 'stats' && !vm.preview.rows.length">No matching records.</p>
        <table class="preview-table" ng-if="!vm.preview.loading && !vm.preview.error && vm.preview.kind !== 'stats' && vm.preview.rows.length">
          <thead><tr><th ng-repeat="c in vm.preview.cols">{{c}}</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr ng-repeat="r in vm.preview.rows">
              <td ng-repeat="c in vm.preview.cols" title="{{vm.previewCell(r[c])}}">{{vm.previewCell(r[c])}}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <div ng-if="!vm.preview.loading && !vm.preview.error && vm.preview.kind === 'stats'">
          <p class="hint" ng-if="!vm.preview.stats.length">No result.</p>
          <p class="hint" ng-repeat="s in vm.preview.stats"><strong>{{s.label}}:</strong> {{s.value}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="modal-overlay" ng-if="vm.confirm.open" gs-modal="vm.closeConfirm()" gs-modal-focus="confirmCancelBtn">
    <div class="modal modal-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="confirmTitle">
      <div class="modal-head">
        <span id="confirmTitle">{{vm.confirm.title}}</span>
        <button class="icon-x" type="button" aria-label="Close" ng-click="vm.closeConfirm()">✕</button>
      </div>
      <p class="modal-hint">{{vm.confirm.body}}</p>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button id="confirmCancelBtn" class="out-btn" type="button" ng-click="vm.closeConfirm()">{{vm.confirm.cancel}}</button>
        <button class="out-btn danger-btn" type="button" ng-click="vm.confirmAccept()">{{vm.confirm.ok}}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
</div>]]></template>
</sp_widget>
</record_update>
